book: Davidson's Principles and Practice of Medicine (25th Edition)
title: Cardiovascular Disease
description: Declarative topic manifest defining discrete clinical bridge note topics for Davidson Chapter 16.

topics.title: Cardiac Auscultation & Pathological Murmurs
topics.scope_declaration: Biophysical origins of murmurs, 7-attribute auscultation framework, Levine grading, systolic/diastolic murmurs, peripheral signs of AR, and dynamic maneuvers.

topics.title: Heart Failure Pathophysiology & Management
topics.scope_declaration: HFrEF vs HFpEF mechanisms, neurohormonal activation (RAAS, SNS, natriuretic peptides), Framingham diagnostic criteria, NYHA classification, GDMT quadriple therapy, and acute pulmonary edema resuscitation.

topics.title: Valvular Heart Disease (Aortic & Mitral Syndromes)
topics.scope_declaration: Rheumatic and calcific etiologies of AS, AR, MS, and MR; hemodynamic pressure gradients, natural history, echocardiographic severity criteria, and surgical/TAVI intervention triggers.

topics.title: Ischaemic Heart Disease & Acute Coronary Syndromes
topics.scope_declaration: Atherosclerotic plaque rupture, STEMI vs NSTEMI vs Unstable Angina differentiation, high-sensitivity troponin kinetics, emergent reperfusion (primary PCI vs fibrinolysis), and secondary prevention.
